info.title: WowMart Admin API
info.description:
Versioned REST API for the WowMart admin panel. Every endpoint below is generated from the live route list, so it
always matches what is deployed. Sign in with POST /auth/login to get a bearer token, then send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

Generated by scripts/generate-openapi.php — do not edit by hand.
